title: One message per slide, one chart per message

videos.script: Look at the title of the last slide you made. If it is two or three words, it names a topic. {{topic}} Results. Cancellations by region. Q2 overview. A topic tells the room what the slide is about, and leaves the room to work out what it says. {{leaves}} Now imagine the title is a sentence. Late first deliveries more than double early cancellations. The room knows the point before it looks at the chart. {{sentence}} Then the chart has one job. To show the evidence for that sentence, and nothing else. {{chart}} This lesson is about that pairing. One message per slide, written as a sentence. One chart per message, chosen to show it. And what to do when a slide is trying to say two things at once. {{two}}
